title: Bottling Plant Manager
text:
**Job Summary**

Lead bottling plant operations from production planning through finished-product quality. You’ll coordinate people, equipment, and supply chain activity to keep production organized, safe, and responsive to changing priorities. Use production data and systems to identify issues, guide decisions, and strengthen day-to-day performance.

**Responsibilities**

* Direct production management, scheduling, and planning for bottling and assembly operations; align staffing, materials, and equipment with production needs.
* Your impact: By coordinating production and quality control, you help teams deliver consistent products and keep supply moving to customers.
* Lead plant teams, set clear priorities, and communicate across manufacturing, quality, maintenance, and supply chain functions.
* Monitor production management systems and enterprise resource planning (ERP) tools, including SAP; use material requirements planning (MRP) and supply chain analytics to support decisions.
* Analyze data in Microsoft Excel, track operational performance, and lead continuous improvement using Lean manufacturing, Lean management, and Six Sigma methods.

**Qualifications**

* Experience in plant management, manufacturing management, production management, or operations management in a manufacturing environment.
* Knowledge of production scheduling, production planning, supply chain management, and ERP systems; SAP experience is relevant.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and Excel data analysis; ability to interpret production and supply chain information.
* Demonstrated team leadership and cross-functional communication skills, with a practical approach to process improvement and continuous improvement.
* Mechanical knowledge and familiarity with quality control, Lean practices, and assembly operations are valuable.

Pay: $31,000.00 - $75,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Employee discount
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person
